But I want to double-check: when `keep_separator=True`, is the separator included as part of the left chunk or the right chunk?

Option A: `[A, B, C]`, `[D]` (separator goes with left chunk - right-side semantics)
Option B: `[A, B]`, `[C, D]` (separator goes with right chunk - left-side semantics)

My implementation does Option A (separator goes with the left/preceding chunk), which is the "right" semantics. This is the standard behavior for most split implementations.
